notes: Data-name-1 and data-name-2 may be qualified (qualification read by the one ReferenceResolver decomposition, kb/Work PB1016). The 2002 rule has no literal-subscript restriction: a subscript is ordinary (8.4.1.2.2), read by SubscriptBinder.ReadSubscripts, while the literal-only rule is 2014 and later (DialectBehavior.ConstantLengthSubscriptsAreLiterals, VCR row 7.121; kb/Work PB5709).
